summary: Even these pasul bird korbanos do not make a person tamei when he swallows them, since melikah counts like shechitah. But using them is me'ilah, except for a bird chatas done the right way, which belongs to the Kohanim.

chunks.en: And all of them do not make tamei in the throat,
chunks.st: And all of the offerings enumerated in the previous mishna, even those that are disqualified and may not be eaten or sacrificed, still differ from carcasses of unslaughtered kosher birds in that they do not render one who swallows their meat ritually impure when the meat is in the throat.
chunks.stMore: This is because the pinching of the napes of bird offerings, like the slaughter of animals, prevents them from assuming the status of a carcass.
